column1: # G4b — deliberate breaks recorded during the V4 port, as a runnable corpus.
# Each row: FILE <tab> FIND <tab> REPLACE <tab> TEST <tab> EXPECT-IN-OUTPUT
# The driver stages the tree, applies the break, runs the test, asserts it FAILS and that
# the message contains EXPECT, then restores with `git checkout --`.
# A break that goes GREEN is a regression the refactor caused.
# A break whose message changes SUBJECT is the "0-ULP compare wearing a slot-rule failure
# message" defect — the gate still fires but sends the reader to the wrong file.
